raw.description:
Are you looking for more than a job? At World Vision Canada we offer challenging careers that change the lives of children all over the world and it will change yours too. Come and be part of a team of 400 Canadians with a vision for the world: Life in all its fullness for every child.

You will experience Christian faith in action helping to make real and lasting change in the lives of the world’s most vulnerable children. Join the World Vision Canada team and be part of a powerful and effective force for good:

For Children. For Change. For Life.

Position: Grant Management Consultant Reports to: People Leader, Program Excellence & Impact Delivery Position Term: Consultant / Independent Contractor Primary Location: Mississauga, Ontario, Canada Workplace Type: Remote (Canada-based; international travel as required)

Job Purpose

The Grant Management Consultant will work collaboratively across Program & Policy (P&P), the World Vision Partnership, and with Field Offices, Regional Offices, and the Global Centre to support delivery against P&P’s three strategic priorities: Impact, Income, and Influence.

The Consultant will provide end-to-end grant management expertise to optimize resources, strengthen delivery quality, and ensure institutional donor-funded projects are implemented in line with approved project design documents, donor agreements, and World Vision standards. This includes providing technical guidance, monitoring and evaluation support, and strategic oversight throughout the grant lifecycle.

The Consultant will serve as a subject-matter expert for assigned grants and relevant geographic, management and/or technical areas, synthesizing and communicating project progress, results, risks, and learning to a range of internal and external stakeholders. They will work alongside peer consultants and internal teams to coordinate workloads, troubleshoot challenges, and contribute to communities of practice and knowledge sharing.

Responsibilities

  • Provide grant management and advisory support to ensure high-quality execution, effective risk management, delivery of intended outcomes, and fulfillment of donor commitments and contractual obligations.
  • Oversee implementation progress to ensure results and donor reports are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with institutional donor requirements.
  • Design and operationalize reporting and learning processes that communicate results clearly and incorporate lessons learned to strengthen ongoing and future grant implementation.
  • Apply Results-Based Management (RBM) approaches and tools to track progress against objectives, outputs, and outcomes.
  • Coordinate and/or contribute to key grant deliverables, including project start-up workshops, partner agreements, workplans, donor reports, annual reviews, evaluations, and project close-out activities.
  • Support knowledge management and learning by documenting and sharing project achievements and insights through partnership meetings, donor engagement, academic forums, and print and digital communications.
  • In collaboration with WVC MEAL and technical specialists, provide technical support for assessments, surveys, evaluations, and the establishment of monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning (MEAL) systems.
  • Work closely with the Grant Finance Officer and WVC Legal team to support the preparation, review, and negotiation of donor contracts and amendments.
  • In collaboration with Program Finance, monitor project financial performance, including expenditures, cash flow, recovery of overheads, financial risks, and funding timelines, and flag risks or issues requiring corrective action.

Qualifications

  • University degree in international development, community/social development, business development, or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of demonstrated experience managing or advising on institutional donor-funded international grants and projects.
  • Strong experience applying Results-Based Management approaches and designing or supporting Monitoring & Evaluation systems.
  • Proven experience supporting or coordinating remote, cross-functional, and cross-cultural teams delivering development projects.
  • Experience engaging with academic and/or research partners is an asset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information clearly for diverse audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly in reviewing project documentation and providing high-quality technical feedback.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively across organizational boundaries and cultures to support alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Ability to manage multiple streams of work simultaneously with sound judgment, initiative, and confidence.
  • Availability and willingness to travel internationally as required (approximately once per year), including to higher-risk environments.

Why Consider Us?

  • World Vision Canada has consistently been awarded Canada and GTA top employer awards.
  • We are Canada’s largest development, relief, and advocacy non-profit organization.
  • We embody an Agile mindset here.

Nature of the Engagement This is a consulting engagement, and the successful candidate will operate as an independent contractor or consultant. Specific deliverables, timelines, level of effort, and engagement duration will be defined in a contract or terms of reference.

This posting is to establish a pre-qualified consultant talent pool for grant-funded work. It is not an active role and does not represent an immediate contract or employment opportunity.

We are proactively identifying independent consultants who may be engaged on a contract basis should grant funding be approved.

We bring life-saving support in times of disaster. We help poor communities to take charge of their futures. We provide small loans and training that boost family livelihoods. We work with policy makers to change the way the world is run. Our Christian faith teaches us that every child, regardless of gender, faith or race, is a precious gift to the entire world - and that their wellbeing concerns us all. We shall never rest while children suffer in situations that can be changed.

Canada's Top 100 Employers GTA Top 100 Employers

Our Core Values: We are committed to the Poor. We are Christian. We are Stewards. We value People. We are Partners. We are Responsive.

Qualified candidates must be able to demonstrate a commitment to the core values and mission of the World Vision partnership.

World Vision Canada takes our Safeguarding responsibilities seriously and we provide an environment that is safe for our child and adult beneficiaries. We have strong recruitment procedures to make sure the safest and most suitable people work with the children in our programs. We provide our staff and volunteers with ongoing supervision, support and training in their work with child and adult beneficiaries.

World Vision Canada welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Thank you for your interest; however only those applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.

The Thought Leader Liaison (TLL), Hematology builds and manages strategic relationships with a select group of U.S. external experts (EEs), with a deliberate focus on cultivating partnerships and insights across both academic and community oncology settings to ensure commercial strategies reflect the realities of where patients receive care.

This role is accountable for generating strategic insights, translating science to actionability, and building brand advocacy. This includes leading strategic engagement with key external experts through robust engagement planning and insight generation aligned to brand and therapeutic area strategies. The TLL generates strategic insights through ongoing interactions with external experts, congresses and executive engagements, while working closely with US/Global Commercial, Medical, and Regulatory partners to translate field perspectives into meaningful business actions that shape brand strategy.

TLLs support the oncology in-line brands within their geography while helping prepare the organization for successful oncology launches through disease-state engagement, external expert partnership, and insights that inform future commercial strategy.

Six geographies will cover the United States, each aligned with an Oncology Field Vice President, who will be an important stakeholder.

Key Responsibilities

External Expert Engagement & Relationship Management

  • Develop and execute regional strategic external expert engagement plans designed to build long-term partnerships while generating meaningful commercial insights, especially within the community setting.
  • Plan and execute External Expert engagements aligned to brand priorities and External Expert needs outside of advisory and congress events, planning and maintaining a consistent level of execution as aligned with TLL Director. This includes a mix of live and virtual engagements in your geography.
  • Build regional brand advocacy segment and manage a thought leader network (network mapping) to optimize engagement and insight generation.

Insight Generation & Strategic Impact

  • Gather and synthesize regional insights from external experts through forums such as 1:1 interactions, congress, publication, and provide them to the brand team.
  • Share synthesized insights with commercial leadership to help shape the following, but not limited to, brand strategy, resource allocation, customer engagement strategies, and launch planning.
  • Help identify emerging treatment paradigm shifts in your respective region, competitive dynamics, biomarker evolution, and unmet needs that may influence future commercial strategy.
  • Seek compliant External Expert feedback on initiatives and materials.

Advisory, Peer to Peer & Congress Engagements

  • Execute and synthesize advisory boards, expert consultancies, and other strategic engagement forums to answer critical business questions and inform commercial decision making.
  • Coordinate and support External Expert executive interactions with commercial leadership.
  • Shape peer-to-peer education content through speaker identification, training/operations support, and relationship management.
  • Participate in key local, regional, and national congresses and serve as onsite host for congress product theater speakers and EEs.
  • Capture and synthesize congress insights to identify emerging trends, competitive developments, and implications for brand strategy.

Cross‑Functional & Operational Excellence

  • Partner effectively with medical, legal, compliance, regulatory, and marketing teams to ensure external engagements are strategically aligned and within GSK policies and adhering to PHARMA guidelines
  • Apply strong project management skills to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Manage agency and vendor partners to ensure timely, high‑quality execution.
  • Understand risk associated with the activities on Strategic Engagement and be adept and agile in their management and mitigation.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in field sales, product marketing, or medical/clinical roles within pharma or biotech.
  • Oncology experience required.
  • Experience presenting to executive audiences (live and virtual) and influencing strategic decisions or stakeholder alignment.
  • Experience leveraging insights to guide strategy development and proactively refine approach in response to evolving data and market dynamics.
  • Valid driver’s license.
  • Willingness to travel 60–80%, including nights and weekends.
  • Ability to communicate effectively to hcps and executives.
  • Experience and knowledge with technology, software and adaptability to learn new AI tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as an Oncology TLL
  • Multiple Myeloma and Myelofibrosis
  • Master’s degree.
  • Strong account management and cross‑functional leadership experience.
  • Marketing and/or sales management background.
  • Advanced project management and organizational skills.
  • Proven adherence to regulatory and compliance standards with proactive risk identification and mitigation.

Overview

SOS International, LLC (SOSi) is seeking “Non-Standard English” (i.e. Urban English/Ebonics) speakers in multiple locations across the US. The ideal candidate will be responsible for a full range of activities in processing material or participating in situations requiring advanced understanding of the required vernacular or language (you chose) including summarization, translation, and transcription source materials obtained from government agencies investigations.

Essential Job Duties

  • Monitoring, translating, transcribing, interpreting, performing quality control and validating services.
  • Providing reliable and accurate transcriptions, translation, or interceptions and/or summaries of source materials or intercepts into English.
  • Capable of performing multi-functional duties; i.e., when not intercepting, the linguist shall transcribe or translate source materials/documents and/or perform quality control functions on documents/materials completed by other linguists.
  • At the Government’s expense, attend sponsored training pertaining to the operation and upgrade of specific equipment and software utilized by our client. The equipment and software may include audio recording machines, computerized word processor/data management software and other pertinent equipment determined necessary by our client.
  • Perform, as required, administrative duties related to tasks. Such duties may include but are not limited to placing log sheets, line sheets, duplicating tapes and/or summaries into binders, copying and stapling related paperwork, and labeling storage boxes.
  • Attend minimization briefings conducted by the U.S. Attorney’s Office and our client. Understand and comply with Court regulations concerning minimization procedures.
  • Testify in court as “Fact Witness” if required by our client and U.S. District Attorney’s office attesting to the accuracy and validity of the work completed by the linguist.
  • Prepare transcriptions of a variety of source exhibits including, but not limited to, video and audio recorded conversations, documents as well as written typed materials such as legal documents, diaries, computerized files, personal papers, maps, charts, ledgers, emails, and internet-based communications or social media (WhatsApp, Facebook, Messenger).

Minimum Requirements

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Law Enforcement Sensitive clearance, based on a Single Scope Background Investigation (SSBI).
  • HS diploma or equivalent training and education.
  • A minimum of four (4) years combined work and educational experience in translating, interpreting, or other work requiring the use of English and another language at the native or near-native level.
  • Applicant must undergo or provide proof that you have successfully completed a language proficiency testing at the minimum proficiency level standards required in the contract at a rating of 3 or above in speaking, listening, reading, and writing.
  • Excellent command of the English language and have the ability to provide clear, concise, oral, and written communications.
  • Skills necessary to listen to and comprehend a foreign language with native or near-native ability, and to follow accurately the basic elements of conversation, whether written or verbal.
  • Skills necessary to read and comprehend a foreign language with a native or near-native ability, and to read and understand various text-types.
  • Ability to comprehend slang and colloquial expressions in a foreign language and translate them into their English equivalent.
  • A sufficiently broad vocabulary in English that paraphrasing or explaining is unnecessary.
  • Ability to work well under pressure to meet specific deadlines.
  • A minimum of 40 wpm typing/word processing skills. The Government may waive the basic typing skill proficiency level under extenuating circumstances. The COR will evaluate the circumstances on a case-by-case basis.
  • Ability to understand the specific tasks being processed and produced.
  • Ability to effectively understand face-to-face speech with sufficiently broad vocabulary that paraphrasing, or explanations are unnecessary.

Work Environment

  • Must be willing to work weekends.
  • Must work flexible schedule

Working at SOSi

All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against for any reason.

Founded in 1989, SOSi is among the largest private, founder-owned technology and services integrators in the defense and government services industry. We deliver tailored solutions, tested leadership, and trusted results to enable national security missions worldwide.

Summary:
As a member of the content development team, you will conduct in-person and virtual workshops with subject matter experts (SMEs) to write and review test questions and assemble examinations. You will evaluate test items applying best practices in assessment, including the use of statistical performance data. You will also be responsible for managing item banks as well as ensuring that test schedules are developed, maintained, and executed.

The item and exam building tasks performed in this position have a high impact on the business interests of the company. You will be supported in developing error-free exams with training and resources, assistance from your manager and teammates, and quality control (QC) activities conducted by the test publishing quality assurance team.

Responsibilities:

As a content developer, you will...

  • Use proprietary item/exam development and banking software to maintain and manage test content (items) and associated elements throughout the exam lifecycle for accuracy, quality, validity, style guide adherence, and Pearson VUE standards.
  • Understand intellectual property confidentiality and security considerations and abide by defined business practices to provide appropriate protection.
  • Partner with clients and cross functional teams on multiple exam programs and deliverables, monitoring scope and deadlines and escalating risks when needed. Assist in startup process for new clients.
  • Plan and facilitate item and exam development activities with clients and their subject matter experts (SMEs) as per contract and exam needs.
  • Evaluate exam program needs using statistical data and other criteria to evaluate items and item bank health.
  • Recommend item and exam development activities and contribute to schedule planning.
  • Prepare materials, including training presentations, for test development meetings. Conduct all aspects of meeting planning: SME recruitment, hotel and catering contracts, travel arrangements, and expense reporting.
  • Establish test development meeting goals for item writing and review and define a test development schedule to achieve those goals. Facilitate virtual and in-person workshops where SMEs write and review examination items.
  • Contribute to all job analysis and standard setting meetings in collaboration with psychometric team, including SME recruitment, materials development, and meeting attendance.
  • Assemble examinations within proprietary item development software and perform QC.
  • Adhere to established QC processes and guidelines, ensuring accuracy of test content components and item set selection per specs, SME input, psychometric input, and scoring parameters.
  • Collaborate effectively with members of testing services teams and other cross-functional Pearson teams, providing timely and complete input on reports, documentation, projects, teams, meetings, and process improvements.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Experience as content or test developer, related coursework, or direct applicable experience

  • Experience with regulatory testing/professional licensure and/or the real estate or insurance industry desirable

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:

  • Initiative and troubleshooting
  • Passionate about quality and attention to detail (e.g., proofreading)
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Strong facilitation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to learn a variety of technical systems and applications
  • Ability to coordinate work schedule with Eastern time zone, when needed
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (e.g., Outlook, Excel, Word, SharePoint, OneDrive)

Work environment:

  • Use of phone, PC, and keyboard for data input
  • Remote work with the ability to travel to a local Pearson VUE office when needed
  • Ability to negotiate transportation for off-site meetings and to carry and keep on-person a laptop during transport

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

The Collections Risk Management Lead is a key member of the Flex Risk Management Leadership Team (reports to the Chief Risk Officer) who will have the opportunity to take the Fraud Risk Management function at Flex to a level that rivals the best in class.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end collections risk management for Flex's credit card portfolio across consumer and small business segments — end-to-end meaning full lifecycle coverage from early delinquency through post charge-off recovery:
    • Early stage collections: monitor roll rates and delinquency migration across DPD buckets; design and refine treatment strategies by risk segment, balance tier, and obligor type; optimize contact timing, channel mix, and messaging to maximize cure rates before accounts deteriorate further
    • Late stage collections: manage pre-charge-off intervention strategies; own the analytical framework for determining when accounts warrant accelerated action versus continued treatment; maintain visibility into cure and re-default patterns by treatment cohort
    • Hardship & modification management: maintain analytical visibility into hardship program utilization, modification outcomes, and re-default rates; identify where hardship programs are being used appropriately versus as avoidance behavior
    • Settlement strategy: define settlement authorization frameworks by balance tier, DPD, and obligor type; evaluate the NPV trade-off between discounted resolution and continued collection effort; govern agency settlement authority to avoid both under-recovery and adverse selection among accounts that would have paid in full
    • Vendor & agency management: define the strategic boundary between in-house collections and third-party placement — knowing when to keep accounts internal and when placement generates better expected recovery net of cost; evaluate and manage agency relationships on the basis of liquidation rates, compliance posture, consumer treatment standards, and cost-to-collect; own the KPI framework for vendor performance and hold agencies accountable to it
    • Litigation: identify accounts where legal escalation is warranted based on balance size, recovery probability, and obligor profile; maintain an analytical framework for litigation referral thresholds and track outcomes by segment; understand the owner-as-guarantor dimension in SMB accounts and where personal liability creates additional recovery optionality
    • Charge-off & recovery: own charge-off timing policy and its interaction with loss reserve mechanics; build and maintain recovery rate forecasts by vintage, segment, and channel; track net loss emergence and recovery curves over time
    • SMB-specific collections dynamics: apply a distinct analytical lens to small business obligors — seasonal cash flow patterns, owner-business financial entanglement, and the limits of standard consumer treatment strategies in a business context
  • Build and maintain collections performance frameworks that surface deterioration signals early and enable proactive treatment rather than reactive loss management
  • Synthesize data across sources — payment history, bureau refreshes, transaction behavior, contact records, and macro indicators — to segment the delinquent population intelligently and match treatment intensity to recovery probability
  • Lead periodic collections reviews: own the data, design the narrative, and present delinquency trends, recovery performance, and vendor outcomes to risk committees and senior leadership
  • Partner cross-functionally with credit, legal & compliance, finance, and operations to ensure collections strategy is aligned with loss reserve inputs, regulatory obligations, and customer experience standards
  • Contribute to stress testing and loss forecasting: model collections performance under adverse conditions and translate recovery assumptions into net loss projections
  • Serve as the internal SME on collections analytics — establishing measurement standards, treatment logic, and vendor governance frameworks as the portfolio scales

Qualifications

    This role sits in the foundational build path of core risk management disciplines, and we expect significant upward potential for the right candidate. The emphasis is on finding colleagues with a strong foundation more than a ‘minimum number of years’ constraint. We can work with people who have 7–15 years of hands-on Collections risk management experience; direct exposure to both a bank or regulated card program and a fintech strongly preferred
    Hands-on familiarity with the full delinquency lifecycle: DPD bucket management, treatment strategy design, charge-off policy, recovery curve modeling, and net loss attribution
    Practical experience managing or working alongside third-party collections agencies — understands liquidation economics, placement timing trade-offs, cost-to-collect dynamics, and how to build a KPI framework that holds vendors accountable without creating perverse incentives
    Analytically self-sufficient: proficient in SQL and Python or R; capable of building roll rate matrices, cure rate cohorts, and recovery forecasts from raw data rather than consuming pre-built reports
    Familiar with the regulatory overlay on collections: FDCPA obligations, Reg F communication rules, UDAAP considerations in treatment strategy design, and state-level restrictions that affect contact and remediation practices
    Understands the distinct dynamics of SMB collections — cash flow seasonality, the owner as guarantor, and where standard consumer treatment logic breaks down

Mindset

    Operates at a senior thinking level relative to peer cohort — brings a point of view on collections strategy, challenges treatment assumptions, and drives the recovery agenda without waiting to be directed
    Thinks about collections as a risk management discipline, not a call center operation — brings analytical rigor to treatment design, vendor selection, and loss forecasting, not just operational execution
    Balances recovery maximization with consumer and business treatment standards — understands that how you collect matters as much as how much you collect, particularly in a regulated and reputationally sensitive environment
    High quantitative aptitude: strong intuitive feel for what roll rates, cure rates, and recovery curves should look like by segment and vintage, and catches anomalies before they surface in reviews
    Effective communicator who can translate delinquency and recovery dynamics into crisp narratives for risk committees, finance, and senior leadership — equally comfortable in the data and in the room

POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. We deliver Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Anything-as-a-Service (XaaS) cloud technology solutions across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, retail, government, education, telecom, technology e-commerce, and financial services. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

Are you a proactive and tech-savvy sales professional with a strong background in B2B lead generation and CRM systems? We’re looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help drive business growth by identifying, qualifying, and scheduling high-value leads for our sales team.

In this role, you’ll leverage your expertise in platforms like Salesforce or HubSpot to manage outreach, track engagement, and ensure seamless handoffs to account executives. If you’re results-oriented and fluent in English, this is your opportunity to make a measurable impact.

To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Key Responsibilities:

  • Apply B2B sales strategies to identify and research prospects across target industries
  • Generate and qualify leads via outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach
  • Use CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) to manage lead data and track engagement
  • Maintain accurate documentation of all lead interactions and activities
  • Communicate the value proposition of products/services clearly and persuasively
  • Qualify leads based on budget, need, timeline, and decision-making authority
  • Schedule meetings and product demos using CRM-integrated scheduling tools
  • Align lead generation efforts with sales and marketing strategies
  • Provide feedback on lead quality and campaign performance
  • Meet or exceed KPIs related to outreach, lead qualification, and CRM usage
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with potential B2B clients
  • Capture and report customer feedback to inform future outreach strategies

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT FOR THIS POSITION?

All positive, and driven applicants are encouraged to apply. The Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated and dedicated and should possess the below qualities:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred)
  • 3+ years of experience in B2B sales development, lead generation, or similar roles
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and KPIs
  • Advanced proficiency in CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or equivalent)
  • Excellent command of English and strong interpersonal communication skills
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn new tools and systems
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven

Supervisors/Managers: ₱120,000 coverage

Role Overview

New York Life is seeking a highly skilled Senior ServiceNow Developer to design, develop, and support enterprise platform solutions that enable IT operations, IT asset management, enterprise architecture, and technology governance. This is a hands-on engineering role responsible for developing and enhancing ServiceNow solutions, building enterprise integrations, automating business processes, and delivering scalable platform capabilities across the organization.

The ideal candidate has deep hands-on ServiceNow development experience and a strong background building enterprise workflows, integrations, and platform automation. Experience with LeanIX Enterprise Architecture is considered a plus and will support enterprise architecture and application portfolio management initiatives.

What You'll Do:

ServiceNow Development (Primary Responsibility)

  • Design, develop, and maintain solutions across ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, SAM Pro, HAM Pro, CMDB, Service Mapping, Discovery, and Vulnerability Response.
  • Develop and customize workflows, Flow Designer solutions, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, Script Includes, and scoped applications.
  • Build and maintain integrations using REST, SOAP, Integration Hub, MID Servers, and external APIs.
  • Participate in platform upgrades, testing, release management, and remediation activities.
  • Optimize platform performance through code reviews, query optimization, and technical debt reduction.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex ServiceNow platform issues while ensuring scalability, security, and adherence to development best practices.

Enterprise Integrations, Automation & Cloud Engineering

  • Design and develop enterprise integrations using APIs, MuleSoft, Integration Hub, and custom services.
  • Develop automation solutions using JavaScript, Python, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
  • Utilize AWS services and terraform to support cloud-native integrations and deployment automation.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and operational support capabilities for platform integrations.

LeanIX Administration & Enterprise Architecture (Preferred Experience)

  • Configure and maintain LeanIX fact sheets, meta-models, relationships, lifecycle states, and reporting capabilities.
  • Support integrations between LeanIX, ServiceNow, Apptio, ACA Risk Rating, and other enterprise platforms.
  • Assist with application portfolio data synchronization, reconciliation, and validation processes.
  • Support enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, and technology governance initiatives.

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Collaborate with architects, product owners, platform teams, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute technical leadership across ServiceNow and enterprise platform initiatives.
  • Promote engineering best practices, coding standards, governance, security, and platform reliability.

What You'll Bring:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  • 7+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
  • Strong experience with JavaScript, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, and ServiceNow scripting.
  • Experience implementing and supporting ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, SAM Pro, HAM Pro, and related ServiceNow applications.

Preferred

  • Experience administering or integrating LeanIX Enterprise Architecture.
  • Experience with Apptio or other IT Financial Management/Enterprise Architecture platforms.
  • AWS, Terraform, MuleSoft, and Python experience.

ServiceNow CIS certifications (ITSM, ITOM, SAM Pro, Vulnerability Response).

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $124,000-$177,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Company Overview

At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress.

As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it.

Our Benefits

We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work.Click hereto discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. We have a longstanding commitment to creating an environment where individuals can contribute their best and succeed together. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. By embracing a broad range of perspectives and experiences, we achieve greater success and fulfill our promise of providing financial security and peace of mind to families across all communities. Click here to learn more about New York Life’s leadership in this space.​

Recognized as one of Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies, New York Life is committed to improving local communities through a culture of employee giving and volunteerism, supported by the Foundation. We're proud that due to our mutuality, we operate in the best interests of our policy owners. To learn more about career opportunities at New York Life, please visit the Careers page of .

​Visit our LinkedIn to see how our employees and agents are leading the industry and impacting communities.

Visit our Newsroom to learn more about how our company is constantly evolving to meet our clients' and employees’ needs.

raw.description:
Job Type: Full Time | Location:Texas | Department: Innovation | Reporting to: Manager, VDC | Work Location Type: #remote

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

Reporting to the Manager, VDC, the Electrical BIM Specialist translates IREN's corporate VDC standards into practical, discipline-level execution — interfacing directly with trade contractors, internal design teams, and external design firms on the details of VDC execution for the discipline, and ensuring lessons learned are captured and fed back into company-wide standards.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

Discipline Requirements & Workflows
  • Establish and maintain the discipline-specific BIM requirements for electrical systems — including medium- and low-voltage power distribution, switchgear, UPS, generators, busway, cable tray, grounding, and lighting: modeling standards, level-of-development (LOD) expectations by project phase, content and family libraries, parameter and classification schemes, and model quality checklists.
  • Define the discipline coordination workflow — how models are authored, exchanged, federated, clash-tested, and signed off — and document it in playbooks and templates that project teams and external partners can execute consistently.
  • Review and continuously improve these requirements based on project feedback, working with the other discipline BIM Specialists to keep cross-discipline interfaces, shared parameters, and coordination priorities aligned.
VDC Execution & Model Coordination
  • Perform and lead discipline model reviews across projects — validating model quality, completeness, and constructability for substations and switchgear lineups, generator plants, UPS and battery systems, busway and cable tray runs, panelboards, grounding systems, and lighting and controls infrastructure.
  • Drive discipline-level clash detection and resolution, with particular focus on routing busway and cable tray through congested corridors and white space, maintaining working clearances per code around electrical equipment, and resolving interfaces with mechanical systems and structural framing.
  • Support fabrication-level modeling for prefabrication and modular construction — establishing requirements for prefabricated electrical room modules, skid-mounted equipment, and busway or tray assemblies so off-site manufacturing partners can build directly from coordinated model data.
  • Participate in project coordination meetings as the discipline authority, resolving technical modeling questions and setting the quality bar for what well-executed discipline VDC looks like at IREN.
Trade Contractor & Design Team Interface
  • Serve as the primary discipline point of contact for trade contractors, internal design teams, and external design firms on VDC execution details — onboarding partners to IREN's discipline requirements, reviewing their BIM execution capabilities, and holding their deliverables to standard.
  • Audit incoming discipline models from partners for compliance with IREN requirements, providing structured feedback and working through corrections before models enter federated coordination.
Standards Stewardship & Lessons Learned
  • Capture lessons learned from each project phase — recurring clash patterns, modeling gaps, workflow friction — and convert them into updates to discipline standards, content libraries, and playbooks maintained across the business.
  • Contribute discipline expertise to corporate VDC initiatives led by the Manager, VDC, including technology evaluations, CDE workflows, and integration of model data with downstream systems.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in BIM/VDC coordination or design of electrical power distribution systems in data center, mission-critical, or heavy industrial environments — familiarity with NEC working clearance and equipment access requirements is essential.
  • Expert proficiency with Revit MEP and Navisworks; experience with electrical design or calculation tools (e.g., ETAP, SKM) and prefabrication workflows is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or enforcing discipline BIM standards, content libraries, and coordination workflows across multiple projects or partner organizations.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, prefabrication, and field installation practices for the discipline, with the ability to judge model constructability — not just geometric clash-freedom.
  • Effective communicator able to work day-to-day with trade contractors, design firms, and internal engineering teams, and to hold partners accountable to standards constructively.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience; willingness to travel to project sites and fabrication facilities as required.

Benefits

At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader total rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.

Compensation
  • Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market data for the region.
  • Total Compensation package may be inclusive of annual incentive bonus, equity (long-term incentive).
  • Relocation (as appliable and based on successful candidate circumstances)
Health & Wellness
  • 100% company paid health insurance premiums(medical, dental, and vision)for employees, 75% company paid coverage for dependents
  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Voluntary life, critical illness, and accident coverage available
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) – when combined with theHigh DeductibleHealth Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources
Retirement & Financial Wealth
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Access to financialplanning and legalservices
Time Off & Leave Programs
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
Growth & Development
  • Internal skills training and advancement pathways
  • Professional development to support certifications, continuing education, or role related training
Community & Culture
  • Company events and team-building activities
We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need!

About Peace Out

Peace Out is a prestige skincare brand focused on science-backed solutions for acne-prone skin. Distributed across Sephora, Amazon, DTC, international markets and specialty retail, the company is at an important stage of operational and organizational evolution as it continues scaling across channels and geographies.
We are seeking a highly hands-on VP Finance to help strengthen the company’s financial foundation, improve forecasting rigor and support scalable long-term growth.
This is a high-impact leadership role for a pragmatic finance operator who thrives in fast-paced founder-led environments and is energized by solving complex business and financial challenges.

Position Summary

Reporting directly to the Founder & CEO, the VP Finance will lead the company’s financial planning, forecasting, accounting oversight, cash flow management and financial infrastructure. This role requires a highly analytical, hands-on finance leader with deep experience in inventory-driven, omnichannel consumer businesses, ideally within beauty, personal care, wellness, CPG, apparel, or similar categories. The VP Finance must be equally comfortable operating at a strategic level and diving into the day-to-day financial and operational details of the business. This includes driving forecasting rigor, optimizing working capital, and partnering closely with leadership on inventory planning, margin management and channel performance across wholesale, Amazon and DTC. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic operator who thrives in fast-paced, founder-led environments and brings a strong track record of building financial discipline and scalable infrastructure to support multi-channel growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead budgeting, forecasting and long-range financial planning processes
• Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning and working capital optimization
• Support lender compliance, reporting requirements and financial operations related to the company’s ABL facility
• Oversee accounting functions including AP/AR, payroll coordination, tax support and audit preparation
• Develop reporting frameworks, KPIs and dashboards to improve visibility and decision-making
• Build and maintain financial models to support strategic planning and operational decisions
• Support board materials, investor reporting and financing-related initiatives
• Partner closely with leadership on pricing, margin analysis, inventory planning and business performance
• Improve forecasting accuracy and strengthen financial discipline across the organization
• Help build scalable financial systems, processes and controls to support future growth

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership
• Serve as a key financial partner to the Founder & CEO and leadership team
• Build and lead a high-performing finance organization over time
• Drive accountability, execution discipline and cross-functional alignment across departments
• Support a fast-moving, collaborative and solution-oriented company culture

Qualifications

Required:

  • 10+ years of finance and/or FP&A experience within consumer products, beauty, wellness or CPG, including inventory-driven omnichannel businesses
  • Direct experience in one or more of the following categories: beauty, personal care, wellness, CPG, or similar consumer sectors
  • Experience operating within high-growth, founder-led environments
  • Strong understanding of FP&A, cash flow management, working capital and operational finance
  • Experience supporting multi-channel businesses across wholesale, Amazon and DTC
  • Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills
  • Experience with ERP systems, preferably NetSuite
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or related field

Preferred:

• Beauty, skincare or personal care industry experience
• Experience managing through periods of rapid growth, operational transformation or organizational scaling
• MBA, CPA or equivalent financial background
• Experience with inventory-intensive consumer businesses and lender-managed environments

What Success Looks Like

• Improved forecasting accuracy and financial visibility across the business
• Strong cash flow discipline and improved working capital management
• Increased confidence and rigor across financial reporting and planning
• Scalable financial infrastructure capable of supporting continued multi-channel growth
• A highly accountable, solutions-oriented finance organization

Compensation & Benefits

• Competitive base salary + performance bonus + equity opportunity
• Medical, dental and vision benefits
• 401(k)
• Remote work environment
• Product allowance and employee discount
• Opportunity to help shape the next stage of growth for a leading prestige skincare brand

  • Responsible for expansion of business within Region and Target Account, utilizing all Belden Smart Building and Data Center cabling and connectivity products

Required Skills and Experience

Position Summary

As the Global Institute's work expands, AI has become central to that vision: a force reshaping classrooms and systems, and a tool for connecting practitioners at scale. Launched in November 2025, the AI Literacy & Creator Collective has grown to 1,810 education practitioners across 93 countries, moving educators from dependency on AI tools built elsewhere to agency as co-architects of AI's role in their own classrooms.

The Director of AI and Educational Technology will provide strategic and operational leadership across the Global Institute’s AI and EdTech portfolio:

  • AI Literacy & Creator Collective
  • The Better Future Hub
  • The AI EdTech Entrepreneur Community.

The role sets direction, builds team capacity, secures resources, and represents the GI's AI and EdTech agenda to senior leadership, network partners, and external funders.

About the Global Institute

The Global Institute for Shaping a Better Future fosters global learning among people committed to reshaping education so that young people can shape a better future. By engaging practitioners across borders, the GI surfaces and spreads what works, building leadership while generating new evidence, tools, and resources that accelerate collective progress toward a shared vision: that all children have the education and support to shape a better future.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Drive the AI and EdTech vision for the Global Institute, refining and implementing a strategy that aligns the AI Literacy & Creator Collective, the Better Future Hub, and the AI EdTech Entrepreneur Community with the GI's broader AI learning agenda.
  • Lead the integration of the AI Literacy & Creator Collective into the Global Institute, overseeing its evolution into a more deeply integrated next phase (AI LCC 2.0) and its migration onto the Better Future Hub.
  • Set the strategic direction and product roadmap for the Better Future Hub, the GI's public-facing knowledge commons.
  • Continuously evaluate the evolving needs of the network and the impact of the GI's AI and EdTech work, using these insights to sharpen strategy and resource allocation.

Building Strategic Relationships and Partnerships

  • Support the Chief Learning Officer in cultivating and managing partnerships with frontier AI companies, technology funders, and platform providers (including Anthropic, Atlassian, Zoom, and others) to expand network access to AI tools, training, and infrastructure.
  • Serve as a point of contact for funding proposals tied to the AI and EdTech portfolio, ensuring concept notes and learning agenda documents remain coherent and legible across multiple funders.
  • Work with the Chief Learning Officer and Director of the Global Institute to align AI and EdTech strategy with broader organizational priorities and donor relationships.
  • Support the development of regional chapters of the AI Literacy & Creator Collective, working with network partners to extend the model into new geographies.

Facilitating Strong Network Learning

  • Foster a vibrant, global learning community of educators, alumni, and network staff engaging with AI, ensuring the AI Literacy & Creator Collective continues to scale its reach and depth of engagement.
  • Lead the strategic launch of the AI EdTech Entrepreneur Community, defining its purpose, membership model, and connection to the GI's broader mission and learning agenda.
  • Oversee the content strategy, taxonomy, and editorial workflow for the Better Future Hub, ensuring resources are discoverable, well-organized, and useful to a global, multilingual audience.
  • Champion a learning culture that treats educators as co-architects of AI in education, not passive recipients of tools built elsewhere.

External Engagement and Thought Leadership

  • Serve, alongside the Chief Learning Officer of AI and EdTech, as an internal and external point person for the GI's AI and EdTech work, including identifying speakers for engagements and supporting public-facing communications.
  • Represent the Global Institute at public moments, including the UNGA showcase and other global convenings, articulating the GI's distinct approach to AI and educational equity.
  • Elevate the perspectives of network educators and alumni in global AI and EdTech conversations, advocating for equitable, contextually grounded approaches to AI in education.
  • Support board-level reporting and senior stakeholder updates on the AI and EdTech portfolio as required.

Team and Operational Leadership

  • Build and lead a team supporting the AI and EdTech portfolio, beginning with a dedicated AI Specialist, providing guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure high performance against shared goals.
  • Oversee day-to-day execution across the portfolio, including budget development for the Better Future Hub and AI LCC 2.0, content production, and planning of flagship learning experiences and events.
  • Manage delivery against key performance indicators for funder-supported projects, in close collaboration with finance, network partners, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Capture and analyze impact data and success stories across the portfolio to inform strategy and support donor and board communications.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 8 years of progressive leadership experience in educational technology, AI integration, or global educational transformation.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multi-stakeholder strategic initiatives across global markets or distributed networks.
  • Proven track record in product strategy, content management, or digital platform oversight (knowledge commons/hubs).
  • Experience cultivating strategic partnerships with corporate tech partners, donors, and philanthropic foundations.
  • Technical fluency in generative AI applications, EdTech infrastructure, and pedagogical frameworks.
  • Strong team leadership skills with a track record of hiring, mentoring, and managing high-performing staff.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting at international conferences or board-level meetings.

Additional Desirable Skills / Experiences

  • Deep familiarity with Teach For All's network model and global approach.
  • Fluency in additional languages beyond English (e.g., Spanish, French, Arabic).
  • Prior experience designing entrepreneurship communities or global incubator programs.

What Teach For All Offers

  • Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization’s progress
  • Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
  • Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements
  • And much more!

Application Instructions

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all!

The application deadline is 24 August 2026. Interested candidates are therefore encouraged to submit their applications as early as possible.

Work Authorization

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

Compensation

Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

Travel and Hours

Travel expected, up to 10%. Travel will be primarily within the region for Team Retreats. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

About Teach For All

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations’ under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All’s global organization works to increase the network’s impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

raw.excerpt: Role OverviewPearson Virtual Schools operates learning platforms that serve schools, teachers, and students at enterprise scale, and we are actively rebuilding parts of our technology foundation to be more resilient, secure, and cloud-native.
raw.description:
Role Overview

Pearson Virtual Schools operates learning platforms that serve schools, teachers, and students at enterprise scale, and we are actively rebuilding parts of our technology foundation to be more resilient, secure, and cloud-native. This work sits at the intersection of high-velocity product delivery and the governance expectations of a large, regulated enterprise.

As our Principal Enterprise Architect, you lead transformative architectural initiatives for our core platforms, orchestrating large-scale changes that improve performance, security, and interoperability. You balance strategic planning with hands-on technical execution: guiding teams through detailed designs, leading complex integrations, and making the calls that reduce legacy dependencies and technical risk. Your influence extends to cross-functional steering committees and project boards, where your technical judgment shapes the prioritization of multi-year platform investments.

This is not an ivory-tower architecture role. You will spend real time on designs, code, and incident retrospectives alongside engineering teams, bringing the pragmatic, ship-and-learn instincts of a high-growth startup to an enterprise setting that has to get security, compliance, and reliability right.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture Strategy & Enterprise Modernization

  • Define the north-star technical architecture for PVS's core platforms, aligning business strategy with modern, sustainable cloud topologies.

  • Lead the migration and refactoring of legacy, monolithic, or on-premise systems into decoupled, cloud-native architectures.

  • Own multi-year modernization roadmaps that balance pragmatic delivery with long-term platform health, sequencing initiatives for measurable reductions in legacy dependencies.

  • Present architectural strategy and trade-offs to cross-functional steering committees and project boards, driving alignment and prioritization on platform investment.

Cloud-Native, Event-Driven & API Patterns

  • Design systems for elastic, demand-driven scaling, including workloads that scale to zero when idle and scale out based on real-time queue depth.

  • Architect loosely coupled, event-driven integrations using message brokers and event streams, applying saga patterns to manage complex distributed transactions.

  • Establish API-first design discipline across REST, gRPC, and GraphQL contracts so services integrate cleanly and predictably.

  • Guide adoption of agentic and autonomous processing patterns, including background workers, self-healing units, and AI/LLM orchestration, where they solve real platform problems.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Define, document, and champion architectural patterns and guardrails across engineering teams, ensuring consistency without stifling team-level autonomy.

  • Act as a hands-on technical leader: review designs, unblock complex integration problems, and step into implementation when a team needs it, not just diagrams.

  • Mentor senior engineers and architects on modern cloud patterns, distributed-systems trade-offs, and pragmatic sequencing of technical debt versus new investment.

  • Model a bias for action, bringing an iterative, ship-and-learn mindset while operating within enterprise governance and risk expectations.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Governance

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to engineering & product leaders and executive stakeholders, translating architectural decisions into business impact, risk, and cost.

  • Partner with cybersecurity, data governance, and compliance teams to ensure architectural decisions meet enterprise security and regulatory standards.

  • Evaluate vendor platforms and build-vs-buy decisions, weighing cost, resilience, and integration complexity.

  • Track and report on architecture health: uptime, IT service levels, integration risk, and adoption of modern patterns across business platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering and systems architecture experience, with demonstrated progression into enterprise-scale architecture roles.

  • Significant tenure at fast-growing, internet-based startups, with firsthand experience building under constraints, scaling rapidly, and making pragmatic trade-offs.

  • Proven track record modernizing legacy, on-premise, or monolithic enterprise systems into cloud-native architectures.

  • Deep expertise with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and the foundational patterns that make cloud services resilient and cost-effective.

  • Hands-on experience with event-driven and asynchronous integration: message brokers, event streams (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS EventBridge), and saga patterns for distributed transactions.

  • Strong discipline in API-first design (REST, gRPC, GraphQL) as the contract layer between services.

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, serverless container environments) at production scale.

  • Familiarity with agentic workflows, background/autonomous processing, and modern AI/LLM orchestration patterns.

  • Exceptional communication skills, comfortable pitching architectural vision to executive stakeholders and debugging distributed-systems issues with senior engineers in the same week.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent; advanced degree a plus.

  • EdTech, SaaS, or K-12 platform experience a plus, not required.

Key Behaviors & Attributes

Transformation-Minded: You treat legacy complexity as an opportunity, not a threat, and lead teams into modernization with conviction and empathy.

Bias Toward Action: You bring the ship-fast instincts of a startup into an enterprise setting - pragmatic trade-offs over perfect designs, without cutting corners on risk.

Strategic and Grounded: You translate a multi-year architecture strategy into concrete, sequenced technical decisions that teams can actually execute.

Hands-On by Default: You stay close to the code and the design reviews - this is a working architect role, not a diagrams-only role.

Trusted Advisor: You move fluidly between a C-suite architecture pitch and a debugging session on an asynchronous race condition, and both audiences trust your judgment.

Collaborative by Default: You build guardrails and patterns with engineering teams, not for them, so adoption sticks without heavy-handed enforcement.

Key Relationships

Direct Reports: None — individual contributor role; sets technical direction and mentors senior engineers and architects across teams

Peers: Lead, Solution Architecture; Lead, Service Operations & Cyber Risk; other senior technical leaders within Platform & Security

Cross-functional: Engineering, Product Management, Security, Data Governance, and DevSecOps teams across PVS

External: Cloud and vendor platform partners, Pearson corporate technology

Pearson is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The opportunity

We are seeking a driven and well-connected Business Development Manager to join our Digital team, based in the United States. This is a hunter role focused on originating and closing new enterprise-level merchant relationships, with a particular emphasis on merchants operating significant subscription and recurring billing models.

You will be the tip of the spear for Worldline's growth in the US market - identifying, engaging, and winning new logos by leveraging your deep payments expertise, consultative selling approach, and established network of senior merchant contacts.

This role reports to the Commercial Director and works cross-functionally with product, solutions engineering, integration, risk, and commercial teams to deliver compelling, tailored propositions to prospective clients.

Day-to-day responsibilities

New Business Acquisition

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through to signed agreement for new enterprise merchant logos
  • Build and maintain a robust, qualified pipeline with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM management
  • Develop and execute a strategic territory plan identifying high-value target merchants and clear paths to engagement

Subscription & Recurring Commerce Focus

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the unique payments needs of subscription and recurring billing merchants
  • Articulate Worldline's value proposition around authorization optimization, retry strategies, network tokenization, account updater services, and churn reduction
  • Identify and pursue opportunities in key subscription-heavy verticals including SaaS, streaming/media, digital content, health & wellness, insurance, and membership-based services

Consultative Enterprise Sales

  • Engage C-suite executives, heads of payments, and key decision-makers through a consultative, value-driven sales approach
  • Develop tailored commercial proposals and business cases that address each merchant's specific pain points, processing requirements, and growth objectives
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with professionalism, persistence, and strategic intent

Market Intelligence & Collaboration

  • Stay current on competitive landscape, industry trends, scheme rule changes, and emerging technologies relevant to digital acquiring and recurring commerce
  • Provide market feedback to product and strategy teams to inform roadmap priorities and competitive positioning
  • Collaborate with solutions engineering, integration, and onboarding teams to ensure a seamless transition from signed deal to live merchant

Relationship & Brand Building

  • Represent Worldline at industry events, conferences, and networking forums (e.g., Money20/20, MRC, Transact)
  • Build and nurture long-term relationships that position Worldline as a trusted strategic partner, not just a vendor

Who are we looking for

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:

  • 5+ years of business development or enterprise sales experience in the payments, fintech, or digital commerce industry
  • Proven track record of originating and closing complex, high-value enterprise deals
  • Established network of C-suite and senior decision-maker contacts across major US and/or global merchants
  • Strong understanding of the acquiring value chain - gateway, processing, acquiring, settlement - and how each element impacts merchant outcomes
  • Deep knowledge of subscription/recurring billing payments including Card-on-File transactions, MIT/CIT classification, network tokenization, and recurring scheme mandates
  • Experience developing and presenting commercial proposals including IC++, blended, and tiered pricing models, volume commitments, and SLA frameworks
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • Self-starter mentality with the ability to operate independently in a remote/distributed environment
  • Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally as needed (estimated 20–30%)

Preferred

  • Experience selling into one or more subscription-heavy verticals (SaaS, streaming, digital media, insurance, membership services)
  • Familiarity with cross-border acquiring and multi-currency payment flows
  • Prior experience at an acquirer, PSP, or payment processor (e.g., Adyen, Stripe, Worldpay, Checkout.com, Nuvei, Fiserv, Global Payments, or similar)
  • Understanding of alternative payment methods, 3DS2/SCA, and fraud/risk management in a digital commerce context
  • Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred)

Perks & Benefits

  • Salary range: $114,000 – $120,000 + 50% bonus
  • Benefits package - comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k) with company match; generous PTO
  • Opportunity to play a foundational role in scaling Worldline's Digital business in the US market
  • Access to a global payments platform with broad geographic reach, deep technical capabilities, and a strong product roadmap
  • A collaborative, relationship-driven culture that values long-term partnerships - with merchants, with partners, and with each other
  • Professional development opportunities and exposure to a diverse, international organization

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

Šta možeš da očekuješ od prvog dana angažovanja?

  • Rad od kuće od prvog dana obuke
  • Dodatno privatno zdravstveno osiguranje
  • Uživaćeš i u raznim događajima, takmičenjima, voćnim danima

  • Specifični plaćeni treninzi i obuke koji ce ti pomoci u daljem usavršavanju

Pridruži nam se kao Agent korisničke podrške u oblasti modne industrije za nemački jezik!

  • slanje kataloga sa aktuelnom ponudom i pregledom novih kolekcija
  • provera raspoloživosti proizvoda

  • Odlično poznaješ pisani i govorni nemački jezik (C1/C2)

  • Motivisan/a si i odgovoran/na

U Transcomu smo neumorno posvećeni. Našim klijentima i jedni drugima. Svakog dana neko započne svoje putovanje sa Transcomom. Uzimajući potencijal koji imaju danas i pretvarajući ga u veštine za budućnost. Dobijanje priznanja za naporan rad, timskog igrača i podršku drugima. Zagovaranje pozitivnih, trajnih promena u svojim timovima i zajednicama. Takvi smo mi u Transcomu. Ovde nam je stalo, i navijamo jedni za druge. Uključeni ste, baš takvi kakvi jeste, od prvog dana.
