raw.excerpt: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
raw.description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, field-tested Director of Engineering to lead, scale, and mature our global engineering organization.

In this role, you will be the foundational leader responsible for engineering culture, technical execution, and organizational design. You will manage a talented team of Engineering Managers and Software Engineers, ensuring our platforms remain highly scalable, reliable, and secure.

As a forward-thinking leader, you will also continue to drive the modernization of our development lifecycle. This includes executing a strategic mandate to integrate AI into our development processes, establishing clear baseline metrics to measure and elevate our overall development delivery efficiency.

Core Responsibilities

1. Engineering Leadership & Org Scaling

  • People & Culture: Lead, mentor, and grow a diverse, fully remote engineering team. Build a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and psychological safety.
  • Organizational Design: Structure engineering pods for maximum autonomy and alignment, ensuring clear career ladders and effective succession planning.
  • Product Operating Model Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management leadership to ensure engineering pods operate as empowered, cross-functional teams focused on customer outcomes rather than just output.

2. Technical Strategy & Architecture

  • System Scalability: Oversee the architectural integrity, security, and performance of our high-volume, low-latency ad tech infrastructure.
  • Technical Debt Management: Balance the delivery of new features with the continuous modernization of our codebase, ensuring infrastructure costs are optimized.
  • Risk & Compliance: Maintain robust data privacy, compliance, and security standards across all engineering operations.

3. Delivery Efficiency & Modernization (The AI Mandate)

  • Process Optimization: Establish and monitor core engineering metrics (such as DORA or SPACE frameworks) to identify and eliminate development bottlenecks.
  • AI Integration: Lead the strategic adoption of AI-augmented development tools (e.g., code assistants, automated testing, documentation agents) to eliminate developer toil.
  • Measured Outcomes: Quantify the impact of these modernization initiatives, demonstrating clear improvements in cycle times, deployment frequency, and overall delivery velocity.

Key Success Outcomes

  • Platform Stability & Scale: Maintain high uptime and performance across all product lines while supporting a growing volume of global ad traffic.
  • Delivery Velocity: Increase deployment frequency and reduce cycle times through process optimization and automation.
  • AI Efficiency Implementation: Successfully deploy AI-assisted tooling across the SDLC with a clearly measured, positive impact on developer throughput and code quality.
  • High Team Retention & Engagement: Foster a world-class remote engineering culture with high retention and clear alignment with business goals.

Who You Are

  • The Seasoned Leader: You have 10+ years of engineering experience, with at least 5+ years managing engineering managers in a fast-growing SaaS, Ad Tech, or high-data volume What environment.
  • The Remote Champion: You have a proven track record of managing and scaling highly aligned, culturally diverse, 100% remote engineering teams.
  • Pragmatic Technical Thinker: You possess a deep understanding of modern cloud architecture and distributed systems. You know how to make smart architectural trade-offs that support business growth.
  • Metrics-Driven Operator: You don't guess; you measure. You are deeply familiar with DORA metrics and engineering productivity frameworks.
  • Forward-Looking Innovator: You stay ahead of the curve. You have a practical, realistic understanding of how AI tools can be safely and effectively leveraged to improve engineering workflows.

What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

Assessment Requirement: As part of our hiring process, all applicants who pass the resume screening will be required to complete a TestDome assessment. Only candidates who successfully pass the assessment will be invited to proceed to the Culture Fit Interview.

raw.description:
Aimpoint Digital is a market-leading data, AI, analytics, and operations research advisory and solution engineering firm. We help organizations design, build, and operationalize enterprise-grade data and AI platforms, decision intelligence solutions, optimization systems, and production AI applications.

We are not a commodity consulting firm. We are a technical and strategic partner to organizations that need to move beyond experimentation and deploy AI into real business workflows with the architecture, governance, reliability, and operating discipline required for production.

As enterprises accelerate adoption of Claude and agentic AI systems, Aimpoint Digital is building a focused Anthropic practice that combines strategy, solution engineering, implementation, and adoption. We are seeking a Go-to-Market Leader to help build this partnership as a growth engine inside the business.

About the Role

As the Go-to-Market Leader for Aimpoint Digital's Anthropic partnership, you will be responsible for building, managing, and scaling our commercial motion around Anthropic and Claude-enabled enterprise AI solutions.

This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, business development, AI strategy, solution development, sales enablement, and practice-building. You will shape how Aimpoint Digital shows up in the Anthropic ecosystem, build trusted relationships with Anthropic field, partner, product, and leadership stakeholders, and translate those relationships into qualified pipeline, differentiated offerings, and measurable revenue growth.

You will not be managing a mature, fully defined alliance program. You will be building one. That means creating the GTM plan, identifying the highest-value market plays, activating account teams, coordinating with technical leaders, shaping client opportunities, developing reusable sales assets, and establishing the operating cadence needed to turn the Anthropic relationship into a scalable commercial engine.

The right candidate is commercially sharp, highly organized, deeply relationship-oriented, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. You should understand how enterprise consulting services are sold and delivered, how technology partnerships create leverage, and how AI adoption is changing the needs of business and technology leaders.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with our Head of AI GTM on the commercial strategy and execution plan for Aimpoint Digital's Anthropic partnership, including annual GTM planning, priority market segments, target accounts, solution plays, pipeline goals, enablement priorities, and success metrics.
  • Serve as a primary relationship lead between Aimpoint Digital and Anthropic GTM stakeholders, including partner, field sales, solution engineering, product, and executive contacts.
  • Partner with Aimpoint Digital practice leaders to define market-ready Claude and agentic AI offerings.
  • Develop joint value propositions that connect Anthropic capabilities with Aimpoint Digital's strengths in AI strategy, data platforms, operational analytics, decision intelligence, optimization, and production-grade AI implementation.
  • Drive pipeline creation and progression by coordinating account planning, pursuit strategy, sales plays, demos, executive briefings, workshops, and partner-led client introductions.
  • Build and run the operating cadence for the Anthropic partnership, including internal pipeline reviews, partner touchpoints, QBRs, executive alignment meetings, field enablement sessions, campaign planning, and post-sale feedback loops.
  • Collaborate with marketing to develop targeted campaigns, events, webinars, client workshops, thought leadership, and account-based marketing motions that position Aimpoint Digital as a high-caliber Anthropic implementation and advisory partner.
  • Help develop reusable intellectual property, solution accelerators, reference architectures, implementation playbooks, and executive narratives that strengthen Aimpoint Digital's position in the Anthropic ecosystem.
  • Stay current on Anthropic's product roadmap, Claude capabilities, enterprise deployment patterns, AI safety and governance considerations, pricing/licensing considerations, competitive positioning, and emerging client demand signals.
  • Act as an internal evangelist for the Anthropic partnership by educating consultants, account leaders, and delivery teams on where Claude is most valuable, how to identify opportunities, and how to position Aimpoint Digital's capabilities credibly.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for an entrepreneurial GTM leader who can build structure where it does not yet exist. You are comfortable turning a strategic partnership into a practical business plan, then translating that plan into pipeline, pursuits, assets, operating rhythms, and revenue outcomes.

You have strong commercial instincts and know how to work across sales, partnerships, marketing, solution engineering, and delivery. You can build trusted relationships with technology partners while also challenging internal teams to focus on the highest-value opportunities. You are not satisfied with partner logos or vague ecosystem activity; you care about qualified pipeline, pursuit quality, win rates, delivery readiness, and measurable client impact.

You are credible with executives, field sellers, technical leaders, and consulting teams. You can synthesize complex AI, data, and business considerations into clear market narratives. You are comfortable discussing Claude, GenAI, agentic workflows, enterprise adoption, governance, and value realization without needing to be the deepest engineer in the room.

You should be energized by a build-stage role. This person will help define what the Anthropic partnership becomes at Aimpoint Digital, how we partner with Anthropic, how we sell Claude-enabled solutions, and how we create durable differentiation in the market.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic alliances, GTM strategy, technology consulting, enterprise sales, partner sales, or related commercial roles.
  • Demonstrated experience building alongside hyperscaler, AI model provider, or modern data platform GTM teams.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise consulting services, including how advisory, implementation, managed services, and solution engineering work are sold and delivered.
  • Proven ability to develop GTM plans, account plays, partner strategies, business cases, enablement materials, market-facing content, and executive-ready communications.
  • Track record of driving qualified pipeline, shaping pursuits, influencing revenue, and partnering with partner sales teams or account leaders to progress opportunities.
  • Strong relationship management skills with the ability to build trust across technology partners, executives, field sellers, technical stakeholders, marketing, and delivery teams.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise AI adoption patterns, including use-case identification, data readiness, governance, security, AI risk, model evaluation, human-in-the-loop design, and value measurement.
  • Experience developing or commercializing offerings related to GenAI strategy, AI agents, enterprise copilots, knowledge assistants, workflow automation, AI governance, or AI operating models.

Location

We are actively seeking candidates for full-time, remote work within the United States. Atlanta-based applicants will have the opportunity to work in our headquarters in Sandy Springs, GA.

Overview of the role

The incumbent plans and conceptualises IT strategies, implementing process re-engineering, innovative solutioning and manages projects in the HR business environment to achieve process efficiencies through the effective use of technology.

The incumbent also oversees the administration and functioning of the HR systems and promotes the use of HR Technology (eg. Power Automate, RPA, etc) and systems across.

In addition, the incumbent will perform the role of Subject Matter Expert for various modules and engage key HR business stakeholders for process review, requirement gathering, conduct UAT and communication on new enhancement.

Responsibilities

  1. Process Redesign
  • Work with business stakeholders to review process and propose automation to enhance operational efficiencies.
  • Manage evolution and enhancements of system capabilities.
  1. System Maintenance and Support
  • Attend to queries raised by HR users
  • Assist in troubleshooting for technical software, hardware and network problem within HR.
  • Liaise with external parties on HR application related matters
  1. Project Management
  • Work with users and vendor to realise HR IT strategies
  • Manage users expectations with accordance to project budget and feasibility
  • Gather business requirements or facilitate requirements gathering
  • Lead and manage new projects and initiatives
  1. Change Management
  • Drive buy-in processes before and during HR IT implementation.
  • Plan and oversee process transition.
  • Provide advice on change procedures.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Experience in managing SAP SuccessFactors (Employee Central, Time Off, PMGM, LMS, RCM, Reporting, etc) in large company-wide program implementation
  • Experience in data management of Group Employee Database of large size organization
  • Familiarity with automation tools (RPA, Power Automate, Power Query, etc) is an advantage
  • Strong data sense, eye for details, highly energized and great multi-tasking ability
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality in all aspects of job responsibilities
  • Ability to work independently as well as engaging with various stakeholders
  • A Bachelors Degree in relevant scope
  • Minimum of 6-8 years of progressive experience in an HR / HRIS / Operations function
  • Proficient with MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint

They require confident professionals with exceptional verbal communication skills and a native-level command of the language.

Only Candidates that Speak, Read and Write in Fluent German to apply, also must have Technical Sales Experience - This is not a call centre position.

The Role:

The primary focus is Outbound Appointment Setting. SDRs will be responsible for proactive outbound prospecting and qualifying leads to book high-quality meetings for our Account Executives.

Project Variety: Our SDRs work across multiple projects simultaneously. We need adaptable individuals who can pivot between different industries and value propositions effectively.

Technical Requirements: Candidates must have a reliable Fiber internet connection with a minimum line speed of 20 Mbps Upload and 20 Mbps Download.

Experience & Mindset: Candidates must have prior Tech SDR experience and a genuine passion for the "hunt." While leads are provided, the role is heavily focused on cold calling; candidates must be resilient and highly motivated by this environment.

Working Hours & Holidays:

Standard shifts: Monday to Friday, 08:00 – 17:00 or 09:00 – 18:00.

Holiday Policy: We work on South African public holidays and observe all German public holidays off instead. We are open to discussing leave flexibility should a candidate wish to swap specific days.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Fixed base salary, regardless of seniority or prior experience.
  • A performance-based bonus of up to €2,000, paid monthly in arrears. This is based on performance against client business case KPIs.

Equipment: Full IT equipment will be provided by the company.

raw.description:
We are currently looking for a HealthShare Application Engineer -Overnight Shift for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role is responsible for supporting and maintaining InterSystems HealthShare and IRIS environments, including platform administration, production support, automation, CI/CD processes, security integrations, and system performance optimization.

This position requires support of an alternative schedule. Candidates must be available to work either Monday–Friday from 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM EST or 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM EST, with 12-hour weekend shifts (7:00 AM–7:00 PM EST) on Saturday and Sunday.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities:

  • Support and maintain InterSystems HealthShare, Health Connect, IRIS, and related platform technologies in production environments.
  • Develop and implement automation solutions to improve operational efficiency and streamline software delivery processes.
  • Maintain Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and deployment processes.
  • Perform system administration activities including installation, configuration, patching, backup, recovery, and performance tuning.
  • Manage certificate lifecycle activities and support security integrations including OAuth, SSO, and ADFS.
  • Provide Tier 3 production support and troubleshooting for HealthShare applications and related infrastructure.
  • Configure and support monitoring, alerting, and operational tools to ensure platform availability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in information technology, healthcare IT, or federal government contracting environments.
  • Hands-on experience supporting InterSystems HealthShare, Health Connect, IRIS, Ensemble, or Cache environments.
  • Experience administering Linux/Unix-based systems and large middleware applications.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Experience developing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Ansible, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, CloudWatch, or equivalent solutions.
  • Familiarity with OAuth, SSO, certificate management, and enterprise authentication technologies.
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and modern software delivery processes.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) healthcare systems or other federal healthcare programs.
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability platforms and technologies.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate or similar cloud certification.
  • Experience with Python scripting and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience supporting highly available production environments and on-call operations.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a government clearance.

Benefits:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision.
  • 401k with Employer Match.
  • PTO + Federal Holidays.
  • Corporate Laptop.
  • Training Opportunities.
  • Remote Opportunity.

Note: Selected candidates will be required to complete fingerprinting at a government facility and undergo a background check as part of the hiring process.

Job Summary

Keystone is a fast-growing company seeking top talent employees. If you want to be part of a team with a purpose Keystone may be right for you. We are seeking licensed ACA Telesales professionals to have a pivotal role assisting the company achieve our goal of new customer growth while maintaining an exceptional customer experience and setting a new benchmark in the industry. You will be responsible for promoting our products and services to new potential customers while being supported by Keystone Advisors team. This is a permanent full-time position plus bonus & commissions!

Excepting Applications from the following States: AZ, FL, IL, UT, TX, NM

Position Overview: We are seeking experienced and motivated Medicare Sales Agents for a high-performance remote sales position focused on heavy outbound dialing and lead conversion. Agents will work third-party vendor leads, contact Medicare prospects, qualify beneficiaries, and close enrollments while maintaining full CMS compliance.This role also emphasizes policy effectuation, member retention, and cross-selling ancillary products to maximize client value and long-term retention. Ideal candidates are strong closers who understand relationship-based sales and are comfortable working in a fast-paced outbound environment.

Responsibilities

    • Make high-volume outbound calls to prospects
    • Work and convert third-party lead vendor calls
    • Educate beneficiaries on Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, and PDP plans
    • Build rapport quickly and overcome objections
    • Complete compliant enrollments
    • Strong Follow up skills with clients to maintain policy effectuation
    • Maintain strong member retention through proactive client support and follow-up
    • Must Cross-sell ancillary products including dental, vision, hearing, hospital indemnity, and other supplemental coverage options
    • Maintain accurate CRM notes and follow-up activity
    • Meet daily dialing, talk-time, sales, retention, effectuation, and ancillary sales KPIs

Qualifications

    • Active Health Insurance License required
    • AHIP certification preferred
    • Medicare sales experience required
    • Strong outbound sales and closing skills
    • Experience with retention, effectuation, and ancillary product sales a MUST
    • Comfortable in a heavy outbound dialing environment
    • Self-motivated, competitive, and goal-oriented
    • Reliable internet connection and dedicated remote workspace
    • Experience working third-party vendor leads is a plus
    • MUST be able to get appointed with carriers
    • Excellent attendance and availability required for remote consideration

This role requires a deep understanding of physical layout, bus design, equipment selection, grounding, and constructability. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with utility clients, be self-motivated, and capable of mentoring junior staff.

**This position offers a clear growth path to becoming a Supervising Engineer, with increasing responsibility for project oversight, client engagement, and team leadership.**

    • Conduit Plan & Details

    • Illumination Plan & Details

  • Leading the design and preparation of engineering studies such as:

    • AC Load

    • Illumination

    • Grounding

    • Lightning Shielding

​

  • Apply client standards related to the work

  • Perform/ensure company’s Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) processes are being followed on all design packages

  • Ensure compliance with industry codes (e.g., IEEE, NESC, NEC) and utility standards

  • Continuous improvement of job-related engineering, technical and professional knowledge, skills, and performance

  • Mentor and guide junior engineers and designers

  • Demonstrate leadership potential to support transition into a Supervising Engineer

What we need you to have (minimum qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (focus in power systems preferred)

  • 8+ years of experience in substation physical design for electric utilities

What we would like you to have (professional skills):

  • 12+ years of experience in substation physical design for electric utilities

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain within 6 months

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, MicroStation, or similar design tool

  • Familiarity with substation design standards and practices (IEEE, NESC, utility specs)

Our Client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is seeking a highly experienced and proactive Customer Service Manager to lead and scale its remote Customer Care team.

This is a full-time remote position for a hands-on leader who can build efficient customer support operations, manage and mentor a team of Customer Care Specialists, and ensure an exceptional end-to-end customer experience in a direct-to-consumer e-commerce environment.

About the company

The company is dedicated to transforming family fun with innovative and safety-first trampolines. Founded by parents, for parents, its mission is to craft high-quality trampolines that bring joy and peace of mind to families everywhere.

As a direct-to-consumer brand with its own logistics and delivery network, the company places a strong emphasis on customer education, post-purchase support, and technical assistance related to product assembly and installation. Exceptional customer service is a core value, supported by comprehensive warranties, including natural disaster protection.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in building structured processes, enjoys improving systems, and has deep experience supporting technically complex, self-assembly products in e-commerce.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage, and mentor a remote team of Customer Care Specialists.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve customer service workflows, policies, and SOPs.
  • Own the full customer support lifecycle: pre-sale questions, order management, shipping issues, delivery coordination, warranties, returns, and post-installation support.
  • Build and optimize processes for handling technical support cases related to product assembly, missing or damaged parts, and installation challenges.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high-priority customer issues.
  • Collaborate closely with Operations, Logistics, Warehouse, and Product teams to resolve delivery and technical issues efficiently.
  • Monitor team performance using KPIs (issue resolution time, ticket backlog, quality scores, etc.) and implement improvements.
  • Ensure accurate and consistent CRM usage, reporting, and documentation across the team.
  • Identify recurring customer issues and proactively suggest product, documentation, or process improvements.
  • Train the team on communication standards, de-escalation techniques, and technical product knowledge.
  • Represent the customer voice internally and advocate for an excellent customer experience at all levels.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Customer Service Manager / Customer Support Manager in e-commerce.
  • Mandatory experience with direct-to-consumer brands that manage their own shipping and delivery.
  • Strong background in technical customer support for products that require home assembly or installation (e.g., furniture, fitness equipment, electronics, outdoor equipment, etc.).
  • Demonstrated ability to build, document, and scale customer service processes and systems.
  • Previous people management experience (leading, coaching, and developing support teams).
  • Fluent English with strong verbal and written communication skills (US market).
  • Deep understanding of CRM platforms, ticketing systems, and call management tools.
  • Highly organized, analytical, and process-driven mindset.
  • Calm, empathetic leader with excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing e-commerce environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with Amazon FBM Company
  • Experience working with warranty claims and replacement parts processes.
  • Experience scaling customer support teams in growing startups.

Our Benefits

  • Work for a market-proven, fast-growing e-commerce company.
  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Fully remote work.
  • High level of ownership and influence over customer service operations.
  • Supportive, collaborative work environment.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a customer service system with real impact.

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to drive the growth of Performa, EMCD's B2B payments product. This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and has experience building positioning, go-to-market strategy, and demand generation in crypto, fintech, or payments.

  • Own Performa's positioning, messaging, competitive differentiation.
  • Product marketing: shape the product narrative, test hypotheses, develop ICP profiles, refine value propositions, and run messaging experiments.
  • Lead GTM planning and execution for new features, client segments, and market entries.

  • Partner with PR, ORM, and SEO teams to align narratives and amplify reach.
  • Establish feedback loops with Sales/BD and account teams to continuously sharpen messaging.

Requirements:

  • 3–4 years of B2B (must!) product marketing experience, at least 2 in a startup or early-stage company (must!).
  • Deep domain background in crypto, fintech, or payments — infrastructure layer, not consumer surface.
  • Genuinely hands-on: comfortable owning both strategy and day-to-day execution without delegation.
  • Proven ability to build positioning and GTM from scratch with limited resources.
  • Experience running demand generation campaigns independently — setup, targeting, optimization, reporting.
  • Comfortable managing and updating websites: creating landing pages, editing copy, working with CMS or code-based tools.

﻿If you're excited about building a product from the ground up, shaping its market presence, and making a direct impact on business growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and join us on Performa's growth journey!

What are we looking for?

A proactive accounting professional with a passion for property accounting and corporate financial management. This role will give you hands-on experience across financial reporting, compliance, and process improvement in a supportive and dynamic environment.

What are you expected to do?

Property Accounting

  • Manage month-end processes, including income journals, occupancy and rate journals, and bank reconciliations.
  • Maintain accrual schedules and prepare Profit and Loss statements with variance commentary.
  • Prepare Balance Sheet, GST, and cash flow reconciliations.

Corporate Accounting

  • Support annual audits and fringe benefits tax return preparation.
  • Conduct inter-company reconciliations and review creditor payments, trust payments, and bond refunds.
  • Process corporate credit cards, including GST and GL code reviews.
  • Manage debtors and provide arrears reporting.
  • Provide coverage for Assistant Accountants and complete their tasks during absences.
  • Handle administrative duties and ad-hoc reporting for the Finance team.

Other Responsibilities

  • Identify and implement system and process improvements.
  • Support ad-hoc performance reporting requests from the management team.
  • Provide coverage for team members and ensure adherence to Australian Accounting Standards and governance processes.

You'll be a great fit if:

  • You hold bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or equivalent certification is a plus.
  • You bring at least 3-4 years of experience in property (at least 2 properties) accounting, preferably Australian Accounting.
  • You have relevant experience in end-to-end financial accounting, particularly in preparing multiple full sets of Profit & Loss statements and balance sheet reconciliations independently
  • You have proven experience in variance analysis, with the ability to compare actuals vs. budget and provide insightful commentary on key variances
  • You have strong understanding of accounting standards and principles, and ability to apply them confidently in day-to-day work
  • You have experience supporting budgeting cycles and contributing to ad hoc financial analysis
  • You have experience using accounting systems and tools (e.g., Xero, MYOB, NetSuite, or similar); advanced Excel skills preferred
  • You have excellent stakeholder communication skills, with a track record of working directly with non-finance teams to explain accounting treatments and resolve queries
  • You have an ability to challenge assumptions, think critically, and contribute to decision-making processes beyond basic data entry
  • You have high attention to detail, organizational skills, and a proactive attitude toward continuous improvement

We will be absolutely thrilled if you also have the following:

  • You are proactive in suggesting improvements to systems and processes.
  • You have experience in property accounting or financial management within the real estate sector.

What you gain beyond the role:

  • Remote + Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the best of both worlds—collaborative office days when it counts, balanced with the freedom to work from home.
  • Achieve Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Work in an environment where you're trusted and empowered to work independently, while still having the support you need to deliver your best. Here, flexibility isn't just a perk—it's how we help you perform at your best, without sacrificing life outside of work.
  • Open Culture: Your voice matters, we encourage proactive communication and fresh ideas.
  • Supportive Team: From your very first day to every career milestone, we've got your back—with long-term growth and projects you can truly thrive in.
  • Learn and Grow: Training, coaching, and international opportunities to level up your skills and career
  • Be part of a B-Corp company that puts people and planet first while creating meaningful impact.

Please note: This role is remote; however, we require candidates to be based locally in the Philippines. This is to support occasional onsite activities such as team events, client meetings, or equipment handover. Additionally, local residency is necessary for compliance with Philippines labor laws and employment regulations.

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire hundreds of skillful individuals from a wide variety of backgrounds, genders, and personalities to live out our diverse culture and make a positive impact on the world!

  • Make a social impact: We balance our work for client teams and for society by constantly making a positive impact.
  • Be proactive: We encourage brave thinking and continuous improvement, and drive change through action.
  • Create value: We create measurable values for our stakeholders: our teams, partners, suppliers, investors, and communities.
  • Be fair, open and honest: We foster equality and inclusivity in a supportive environment that embraces diversity and celebrates achievements.
  • Add fun, passion and love: We prioritise fun and passion, fostering higher engagement and a positive can-do attitude.

Trainer / Change Manager
Type: Contract (Time & Materials) – fully remote
Language Requirement: Fluent in English & French

Summary

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Trainer / Change Manager to lead organizational change management and training activities across technology solution initiatives and related releases.

This role will be responsible for developing and executing change strategies, creating communication and training materials, coordinating training delivery, and ensuring business readiness for system and process changes.

The ideal candidate will have strong communication skills, a solid understanding of change adoption best practices, and experience supporting large-scale transformation or technology-driven projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with project teams to plan and execute change management strategies that promote user adoption and minimize disruption.
  • Develop and maintain a structured change management framework, including stakeholder analysis, impact assessments, readiness plans, and adoption tracking.
  • Design, develop, and deliver training content (presentations, job aids, e-learning modules, and videos) tailored to various user groups.
  • Coordinate and schedule training sessions (virtual and/or in-person), ensuring participation across impacted teams and regions.
  • Manage communications related to business and system changes, including announcements, updates, and stakeholder briefings.
  • Establish and maintain a centralized repository for training materials, job aids, FAQs, and user support documentation.
  • Collaborate with business and functional leads to identify training needs for ongoing releases and initiatives.
  • Conduct post-training evaluations and gather user feedback to measure effectiveness and continuously improve delivery.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for end-user queries related to change initiatives and training support.
  • Maintain documentation for change and training activities to support knowledge transfer and ongoing reference.
  • Ensure all change and training activities align with organizational governance and compliance standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement in change management and training practices across the program.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in change management, training, or communications within large-scale transformation or technology solution environments.
  • Proven ability to plan and execute end-to-end change management and training initiatives.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and French.
  • Experience designing and delivering training across multiple formats (instructor-led, virtual, and self-paced learning).
  • Ability to engage with diverse stakeholders and adapt messaging for different audiences.
  • Experience working within structured governance or compliance-driven environments.
  • Proficiency in standard business tools (e.g., document creation, presentations, collaboration platforms).
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and respond within 1 business day

raw.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLEWe're looking for a Salesforce Communications Cloud Order Management Architect for a 12-month contract engagement running in the ANZ time zone.
raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Salesforce Communications Cloud Order Management Architect for a 12-month contract engagement running in the ANZ time zone. You'll be leading the architecture and design of order management solutions built on Communications Cloud, covering order capture, decomposition, orchestration, and fulfilment across a telco product stack.

The role is remote-friendly, but we have a preference for candidates based in ANZ. If you're outside the region, you'll need to be comfortable with ANZ business hours and open to travel when the project requires it.

We need someone who has designed and delivered Communications Cloud OM end-to-end, not someone who has worked adjacent to it. You should be able to walk us through real projects, the decisions you made, and the problems you solved.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Order Management Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end order management architecture on the Communications Cloud platform
  • Design order capture, decomposition, and orchestration flows across complex telco product scenarios
  • Define the order fulfilment framework including fallout handling, jeopardy management, and order tracking
  • Architect the integration between order management and upstream CPQ and downstream BSS/OSS systems

OmniStudio & Platform Design

  • Lead the design of OmniStudio components supporting order flows (OmniScripts, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures, FlexCards)
  • Define orchestration logic and state management across the order lifecycle
  • Ensure the OM architecture aligns with the broader Communications Cloud platform design including EPC and CPQ

Technical Leadership

  • Provide architectural governance across the OM workstream
  • Guide developers on order management configuration, customisation patterns, and integration design
  • Review technical decisions and enforce design standards across the delivery team
  • Define deployment and environment strategy for the OM components

Stakeholder Management

  • Lead architecture workshops and design sessions with business and technical stakeholders
  • Present order management architecture options and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and business decision-makers
  • Produce architecture documentation that is detailed enough for the delivery team to work from
  • Collaborate with CPQ, EPC, and integration workstream leads to keep the architecture cohesive

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Have

  • Specific and demonstrable Salesforce Communications Cloud Order Management architecture experience, with real projects you can walk through in detail
  • Deep understanding of order decomposition, orchestration, and fulfilment patterns within Communications Cloud
  • Proven experience designing fallout handling, jeopardy management, and order lifecycle state management
  • Strong OmniStudio skills at an architecture and oversight level
  • Experience integrating Communications Cloud OM with external BSS/OSS systems
  • Based in ANZ, or able to commit to ANZ hours and travel when needed

Technical Depth

  • Telco order management concepts: order types, service provisioning, activation flows, and network fulfilment integration
  • Integration architecture between Communications Cloud OM and external systems (REST/SOAP, Integration Procedures, middleware, event-driven patterns)
  • Data architecture and large data volume considerations in an order management context
  • Security model design and platform governance for OM environments
  • DevOps and deployment practices for Communications Cloud

Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Certified OmniStudio Developer or Consultant
  • Salesforce Certified Communications Cloud Accredited Professional
  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Technical Architect
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I / II

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience working across the full Communications Cloud stack including EPC and CPQ
  • Background in a consulting or SI environment
  • Agile or SAFe delivery experience at scale

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Specific project examples that show what you architected in OM, the complexity you dealt with, and the decisions you made
  • Relevant certifications that back up your hands-on experience
  • Availability to start within 2 to 4 weeks

We are seeking a Remote Senior Cybersecurity & Compliance Consultant (HIPAA, NIST & SOC 2) to lead cybersecurity and compliance engagements for clients in healthcare, professional services, and other regulated industries. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical cybersecurity expertise combined with deep knowledge of compliance frameworks including HIPAA, NIST, and SOC 2. Responsibilities include conducting cybersecurity and compliance assessments, evaluating security postures, identifying risks and security gaps, developing remediation plans, assisting with policy and procedure development, preparing professional assessment reports, delivering security awareness and phishing training programs, and supporting virtual CISO (vCISO) engagements. This position requires the ability to work independently, communicate effectively with executives, IT teams, compliance officers, and end users, and translate complex security and compliance requirements into practical, business-focused recommendations.   • CRISC
  • CCSK
  • Security+
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer

  • Maintain accrual schedules and prepare Profit and Loss statements with variance commentary.
  • Prepare Balance Sheet, GST, and cash flow reconciliations.
  • Oversee key income and expense streams, such as letting income, departure cleaning expenses, and prepayment expenses.
  • Assist Property Managers with account reviews, annual budgets, and forecasts.
  • Deliver quarterly and annual reports for property owners, ensuring contractual obligations are met.

Corporate Accounting

  • Support annual audits and fringe benefits tax return preparation.
  • Conduct inter-company reconciliations and review creditor payments, trust payments, and bond refunds.
  • Process corporate credit cards, including GST and GL code reviews.
  • Manage debtors and provide arrears reporting.
  • Provide coverage for Assistant Accountants and complete their tasks during absences.
  • Handle administrative duties and ad-hoc reporting for the Finance team.

Other Responsibilities

  • Identify and implement system and process improvements.
  • Support ad-hoc performance reporting requests from the management team.
  • Provide coverage for team members and ensure adherence to Australian Accounting Standards and governance processes.

You'll be a great fit if:

  • You hold bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or equivalent certification is a plus.
  • You bring at least 3-4 years of experience in property (at least 2 properties) accounting, preferably Australian Accounting.
  • You have relevant experience in end-to-end financial accounting, particularly in preparing multiple full sets of Profit & Loss statements and balance sheet reconciliations independently
  • You have proven experience in variance analysis, with the ability to compare actuals vs. budget and provide insightful commentary on key variances
  • You have strong understanding of accounting standards and principles, and ability to apply them confidently in day-to-day work
  • You have experience supporting budgeting cycles and contributing to ad hoc financial analysis
  • You have experience using accounting systems and tools (e.g., Xero, MYOB, NetSuite, or similar); advanced Excel skills preferred
  • You have excellent stakeholder communication skills, with a track record of working directly with non-finance teams to explain accounting treatments and resolve queries
  • You have an ability to challenge assumptions, think critically, and contribute to decision-making processes beyond basic data entry
  • You have high attention to detail, organizational skills, and a proactive attitude toward continuous improvement

We will be absolutely thrilled if you also have the following:

  • You are proactive in suggesting improvements to systems and processes.
  • You have experience in property accounting or financial management within the real estate sector.

What you gain beyond the role:

  • Remote + Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the best of both worlds—collaborative office days when it counts, balanced with the freedom to work from home.
  • Achieve Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Work in an environment where you're trusted and empowered to work independently, while still having the support you need to deliver your best. Here, flexibility isn't just a perk—it's how we help you perform at your best, without sacrificing life outside of work.
  • Open Culture: Your voice matters, we encourage proactive communication and fresh ideas.
  • Supportive Team: From your very first day to every career milestone, we've got your back—with long-term growth and projects you can truly thrive in.
  • Learn and Grow: Training, coaching, and international opportunities to level up your skills and career
  • Be part of a B-Corp company that puts people and planet first while creating meaningful impact.

Please note: This role is remote; however, we require candidates to be based locally in the Philippines. This is to support occasional onsite activities such as team events, client meetings, or equipment handover. Additionally, local residency is necessary for compliance with Philippines labor laws and employment regulations.

Why work for Sharesource?

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire hundreds of skillful individuals from a wide variety of backgrounds, genders, and personalities to live out our diverse culture and make a positive impact on the world!

Our 5 Values:

  • Make a social impact: We balance our work for client teams and for society by constantly making a positive impact.
  • Be proactive: We encourage brave thinking and continuous improvement, and drive change through action.
  • Create value: We create measurable values for our stakeholders: our teams, partners, suppliers, investors, and communities.
  • Be fair, open and honest: We foster equality and inclusivity in a supportive environment that embraces diversity and celebrates achievements.
  • Add fun, passion and love: We prioritise fun and passion, fostering higher engagement and a positive can-do attitude.

Trainer / Change Manager
Type: Contract (Time & Materials) – fully remote
Language Requirement: Fluent in English & French

Summary

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Trainer / Change Manager to lead organizational change management and training activities across technology solution initiatives and related releases.

This role will be responsible for developing and executing change strategies, creating communication and training materials, coordinating training delivery, and ensuring business readiness for system and process changes.

The ideal candidate will have strong communication skills, a solid understanding of change adoption best practices, and experience supporting large-scale transformation or technology-driven projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with project teams to plan and execute change management strategies that promote user adoption and minimize disruption.
  • Develop and maintain a structured change management framework, including stakeholder analysis, impact assessments, readiness plans, and adoption tracking.
  • Design, develop, and deliver training content (presentations, job aids, e-learning modules, and videos) tailored to various user groups.
  • Coordinate and schedule training sessions (virtual and/or in-person), ensuring participation across impacted teams and regions.
  • Manage communications related to business and system changes, including announcements, updates, and stakeholder briefings.
  • Establish and maintain a centralized repository for training materials, job aids, FAQs, and user support documentation.
  • Collaborate with business and functional leads to identify training needs for ongoing releases and initiatives.
  • Conduct post-training evaluations and gather user feedback to measure effectiveness and continuously improve delivery.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for end-user queries related to change initiatives and training support.
  • Maintain documentation for change and training activities to support knowledge transfer and ongoing reference.
  • Ensure all change and training activities align with organizational governance and compliance standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement in change management and training practices across the program.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in change management, training, or communications within large-scale transformation or technology solution environments.
  • Proven ability to plan and execute end-to-end change management and training initiatives.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and French.
  • Experience designing and delivering training across multiple formats (instructor-led, virtual, and self-paced learning).
  • Ability to engage with diverse stakeholders and adapt messaging for different audiences.
  • Experience working within structured governance or compliance-driven environments.
  • Proficiency in standard business tools (e.g., document creation, presentations, collaboration platforms).
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

raw.title: Salesforce Communications Cloud Order Management Architect
raw.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLEWe're looking for a Salesforce Communications Cloud Order Management Architect for a 12-month contract engagement running in the ANZ time zone.
raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Salesforce Communications Cloud Order Management Architect for a 12-month contract engagement running in the ANZ time zone. You'll be leading the architecture and design of order management solutions built on Communications Cloud, covering order capture, decomposition, orchestration, and fulfilment across a telco product stack.

The role is remote-friendly, but we have a preference for candidates based in ANZ. If you're outside the region, you'll need to be comfortable with ANZ business hours and open to travel when the project requires it.

We need someone who has designed and delivered Communications Cloud OM end-to-end, not someone who has worked adjacent to it. You should be able to walk us through real projects, the decisions you made, and the problems you solved.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Order Management Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end order management architecture on the Communications Cloud platform
  • Design order capture, decomposition, and orchestration flows across complex telco product scenarios
  • Define the order fulfilment framework including fallout handling, jeopardy management, and order tracking
  • Architect the integration between order management and upstream CPQ and downstream BSS/OSS systems

OmniStudio & Platform Design

  • Lead the design of OmniStudio components supporting order flows (OmniScripts, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures, FlexCards)
  • Define orchestration logic and state management across the order lifecycle
  • Ensure the OM architecture aligns with the broader Communications Cloud platform design including EPC and CPQ

Technical Leadership

  • Provide architectural governance across the OM workstream
  • Guide developers on order management configuration, customisation patterns, and integration design
  • Review technical decisions and enforce design standards across the delivery team
  • Define deployment and environment strategy for the OM components

Stakeholder Management

  • Lead architecture workshops and design sessions with business and technical stakeholders
  • Present order management architecture options and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and business decision-makers
  • Produce architecture documentation that is detailed enough for the delivery team to work from
  • Collaborate with CPQ, EPC, and integration workstream leads to keep the architecture cohesive

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Have

  • Specific and demonstrable Salesforce Communications Cloud Order Management architecture experience, with real projects you can walk through in detail
  • Deep understanding of order decomposition, orchestration, and fulfilment patterns within Communications Cloud
  • Proven experience designing fallout handling, jeopardy management, and order lifecycle state management
  • Strong OmniStudio skills at an architecture and oversight level
  • Experience integrating Communications Cloud OM with external BSS/OSS systems
  • Based in ANZ, or able to commit to ANZ hours and travel when needed

Technical Depth

  • Telco order management concepts: order types, service provisioning, activation flows, and network fulfilment integration
  • Integration architecture between Communications Cloud OM and external systems (REST/SOAP, Integration Procedures, middleware, event-driven patterns)
  • Data architecture and large data volume considerations in an order management context
  • Security model design and platform governance for OM environments
  • DevOps and deployment practices for Communications Cloud

Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Certified OmniStudio Developer or Consultant
  • Salesforce Certified Communications Cloud Accredited Professional
  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Technical Architect
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I / II

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience working across the full Communications Cloud stack including EPC and CPQ
  • Background in a consulting or SI environment
  • Agile or SAFe delivery experience at scale

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Specific project examples that show what you architected in OM, the complexity you dealt with, and the decisions you made
  • Relevant certifications that back up your hands-on experience
  • Availability to start within 2 to 4 weeks

raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Salesforce Communications Cloud CPQ Architect for a 12-month contract engagement running in the ANZ time zone. You'll be leading the architecture and design of CPQ solutions built on Communications Cloud, working across product catalog, quoting, and pricing to deliver outcomes on a telco-focused project.

The role is remote-friendly, but we have a preference for candidates based in ANZ. If you're located outside the region, you'll need to be comfortable with ANZ business hours and open to travel when the project requires it.

This isn't a role for someone who has observed Communications Cloud CPQ from a distance. We need someone who has designed and delivered it as an architect, and can walk us through what they built.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Solution Architecture & CPQ Design

  • Own the end-to-end CPQ architecture across the Communications Cloud platform
  • Design product configuration, pricing, eligibility, and quoting flows against a complex telco product catalog
  • Define the solution blueprint for CPQ including cart architecture, guided selling, and approval frameworks
  • Lead design workshops with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into architecture decisions
  • Ensure CPQ design aligns with upstream catalog and downstream order management flows

Technical Leadership

  • Provide architectural governance across OmniStudio development (OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures)
  • Guide developers on CPQ configuration and customisation patterns
  • Define integration architecture between CPQ and external BSS/OSS systems
  • Review technical decisions and enforce design standards across the delivery team

Stakeholder Management

  • Present architecture options and trade-offs to technical and business stakeholders
  • Collaborate with project managers, BAs, and delivery leads to keep architecture aligned with scope and timeline
  • Produce clear architecture documentation that the team can actually use

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Have

  • Specific and demonstrable Salesforce Communications Cloud CPQ architecture experience, with real projects you can detail
  • Deep understanding of EPC: product modelling, pricing, bundles, eligibility rules, and catalog governance
  • Proven CPQ architecture: cart configuration, quoting flows, approval logic, and guided selling design
  • Strong OmniStudio skills at an architecture and oversight level
  • Ability to lead design sessions and influence technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Based in ANZ, or able to commit to ANZ hours and travel when needed

Technical Depth

  • Telco BSS/OSS product and quoting concepts at an architecture level
  • Integration design between Communications Cloud CPQ and external systems (REST/SOAP, Integration Procedures, middleware)
  • Security model, data architecture, and large data volume considerations in a catalog context
  • DevOps and deployment practices for Communications Cloud environments

Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Certified OmniStudio Developer or Consultant
  • Salesforce Certified Communications Cloud Accredited Professional
  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Technical Architect
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I / II

NICE TO HAVE

  • Prior delivery on telco or communications industry projects in an architect capacity
  • Experience designing order management or fulfilment flows connected to CPQ
  • Background working in a consulting or SI environment
  • Agile or SAFe delivery experience at scale

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Specific project examples that show what you architected, the problems you solved, and the decisions you made
  • Relevant certifications that back up your hands-on experience
  • Availability to start within 2 to 4 weeks

Role: Vice President - Provider Sales (Hunter)

Location: Remote - United States

Job Description

The role owns the end-to-end deal lifecycle—from origination to closure and early-stage expansion— managing complex sales cycles and ensuring strong post-win ramp-up. It requires orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver integrated, outcome-driven solutions aligned to client priorities, while building and scaling a high-value pipeline. Overall, the role is accountable for driving consistent new revenue growth and contributing to long-term portfolio expansion through strategic, high-impact engagement.

Responsibilities

As part of your duties, you will be responsible for:

1. Strategic Account Growth & Business Development (Named Accounts) - Drive Data & AI led growth strategies across strategic Healthcare Provider accounts, expanding footprint and unlocking new revenue opportunities across subsidiaries

2. New Logo Acquisition & Market Growth - Own new Healthcare Provider logo acquisition, originating, shaping, and closing large, complex deals by positioning integrated Data, Digital, and AI solutions

3. Sales Strategy & Execution - Lead end-to-end sales cycle from prospecting to closure, ensuring strong pipeline creation, disciplined execution, and consistent revenue growth

4. Sales & Revenue Growth - Deliver account growth through upsell and cross-sell of Data, AI and Global Delivery led solutions across Finance & Accounting, Contract Center, Revenue Cycle Management, Provider Analytics, Data Management and other services aligned to evolving client priorities

5. Tech Savviness & Data & AI proficiency in managing and growing client relationships - Build trusted CXO relationships and engage CIOs/CTOs with compelling, context-driven articulation of internal Data & AI capabilities within the client's technology landscape

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Solutioning - Orchestrate cross-functional teams to design and deliver integrated solutions across Data, Analytics, AI, Digital, Finance & Accounting, Contract Center and Clinical Operations

7. Pipeline Development & Conversion - Build and manage a high-quality pipeline with strong conversion discipline and predictable revenue realization

8. Financial Management & Oversight - Drive revenue, pipeline, and profitability performance through strong financial tracking and account governance

9. Market Insights & Competitive Intelligence - Leverage market intelligence to anticipate demand, shape Data & AI offerings, and strengthen competitive positioning

Skills and Personal attributes we would like to have:

1. Thought Leadership in Data & AI - Seen as a credible thought partner to CXOs, with strong understanding of Data, AI, Analytics and tech ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Palantir), enabling articulation of value, limitations, and ROI while influencing strategic decisions and guiding Data & AI-led transformation

2. Sales Cycle Management – Experience managing complex sales cycles, working with technical stakeholders, and negotiating strategic deals

3. Stakeholder Communication – Strong presentation and communication skills with ability to build relationships across all customer levels, from ICs to C-level executives

4. Analytical & Creative Thinking – Analytical approach to understanding customer needs combined with creative solutions to drive expansion

5. Execution Mindset – A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic 'roll up your sleeves' mentality

6. Technology Orientation (Data & AI) – Passion for emerging technologies like AI, with interest in ensuring they are developed safely and responsibly. Translate Data, AI, Cloud, and Domain Ops into client-specific, high-impact solutions

7. Domain & Industry Expertise - Deep understanding of Healthcare Providers Market and evolving client priorities

8. Complex Deal Leadership - Manage multi-stakeholder, large deal cycles and consistently deliver revenue targets

9. CXO Influence & Relationships - Build trusted executive relationships and influence strategic decisions

10. Value Translation - Convert internal capabilities into business-aligned solutions addressing key client pain points

11. Communication & Executive Presence - Articulate complex Data, AI & Global Delivery concepts with clarity and impact

12. Collaboration & Orchestration - Work across teams to deliver integrated, end-to-end solutions

13. Curiosity & Market Awareness - Stay ahead on Data, AI, Digital, and enterprise trends

Qualifications

Qualifications and experience we consider to be essential for the role:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Technology, Business or a related discipline.
  • Preferred (but not mandatory) - Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) from a reputed institution, with a focus on Strategy, Marketing, Finance, or General Management.
  • Minimum 15+ years of demonstrated experience in leading delivery teams, business development, sales, pre-sales or related roles, with a strong track record of success.
  • 8+ years of experience of leading sales in Healthcare Provider sector is required.

Salary Range: $200,000 - $235,000

The posted range is the hiring range for this role — a subset of the broader range available to employees over time — and reflects base salary across our national hiring scale. Final offers are based on several factors, including the candidate's skills and experience, internal pay equity, work location, market conditions for the role, and the specific scope and responsibilities of the position. The top of the range is reserved for candidates who notably exceed the requirements; the lower end applies to those with less experience or fewer preferred qualifications. For positions based in higher-cost zones (e.g., California, New York, New Jersey), actual compensation may exceed the posted range; your recruiter will share specifics during the process.
